# Files from the Pugliese et al. code repository

The files in this directory are unmodified copies from
<https://github.com/smpuglie/Pugliese_2026> at commit
`10e7661bf414ba7b4c2edf795cd36d0f878c17c0`, used as inputs by `pipeline/`:

- `data/manc t1 connectome data/wTable_20250813_DNtoMN_unsorted_withModules.csv`
- `figures/DNg100_Stim-hyak-run_id=33258130/`
- `figures/DNg100_Stim_fullManc-hyak-30662613-33195857-33195876-33195882/nMnsActive_allLegs.csv`

The repository declares the MIT license: its `pyproject.toml` sets `license = {text = "MIT"}`, and its README states "This project is licensed under the terms of the MIT license". Please cite Pugliese et al., bioRxiv (2025), doi:10.1101/2025.09.12.675944.
